*Consumable (substance), legendary*

(Insert Description Here.)

This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. You can use an action to pour the contents of the tube onto a surface within reach. The liquid instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches including [Ultra Grade Cyanoacrylete](/consumable:ultra-grade-cyanoacrylete).
